description: TokenSpeed is a speed-of-light LLM inference engine.
vibe: One path, no defaults, no hidden state — production inference is a contract, not a convenience.
highlights: Single scheduling and execution path: disaggregation, speculation, CUDA graphs, and overlap are parameters of the same path, never a second path.
Parameters selecting execution paths, algorithms, or correctness-critical behavior must be explicit with no defaults; convenience alone never justifies defaulting a behavioral choice.
Per-request state must first be owned by the LCM cache subsystem and C++ scheduler as a cache group; backend-private state is the exception and must implement SlotStateExporter.
Compile-time kernel parameters are part of the JIT cache key — batch-varying values must be runtime arguments or bucketed, guarded by assert_no_triton_compile.
Tests must fail only when the code under test is wrong: test behavior through real classes, not structure, mock choreography, or third-party packages.
assessment: This file treats inference serving as a correctness-critical system where hidden state, implicit defaults, and mode-specific branches are the primary sources of production failure. The insistence on one unified path, explicit behavioral parameters, and slot-state export contracts reflects hard-won lessons from debugging retractions and JIT stalls at scale. The anti-slop rules around tests and mocks are unusually rigorous, demanding behavioral verification over structural assertions.
